answer: Copying an answer therefore yields nothing, and producing 82 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the prism ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the karst review can re-run it. A near-duplicate is rejected at the delta gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
